name: Call of War: World War 2
author: Addicting Games
description: What if World War Two didn't quite go the way we remember? History is not written in stone and through war all things possible. In this massively multiplayer online role-playing game you will play the role of a country during World War Two. You may choose between the Axis or the Allied powers. Your choices in regards to infantry placements, attacks, the types of tanks, and armor that you buy, as well as what you invest in your navy and air force could completely re-define the course of human history. But conquest doesn't just come at the end of a gun. In Call of War, you'll be able to not only conquer provinces but also forge alliances with other players in order to build up your own economy. At its heart, Call of War is a resource management game. So, you'll also be investing time and money into researching secret weapons which might bring about the end of the war.
